submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on language that specifies a person's particulars: possessive determiners marking a personal relation or event (his birthday, my first day, your home), enumerated kin and family-life terms (two children, married, family leave), body/health specifics (menstruation, teenage pregnancy), and formal personal-status designations such as charges, statutes, or titled works (First Degree Rape, Family and Medical Leave Act, autobiography My Life). Plain object/action language with articles and bare common nouns (the birthday, his wallet, the red book, kicked the ball) stays near zero.
